Messages.Author: the1andonlime
Messages.Body:
On the phone now, so I don't have easy access to card text.

What happens to the equipment under Delivery Truck if the action to equip it fails (blocked or cancelled or fizzles)?

Does it stay on the Truck or does it burn?

Edit:
>
> Name: Delivery Truck
> [Anarchs:R, KoT:R]
> Cardtype: Equipment
> Vehicle.
> During your master phase, you may show a non-location equipment card from your hand to the other players and place it face down on the Delivery Truck if it doesn't already have one. You may look at the card at any time. Any minion you control may equip that card (face up) as a +1 stealth action (requirements and cost apply as normal). A minion may have only one vehicle.
> Artist: Jeff Holt
>

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
It stays on the Delivery Truck (much like an action to equip from another minion you control).
